relations.name: facility
relations.meaning: A manifest NPDES facility identified by permit number in source evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to sources/source_manifest.json facility entry and any structured row bearing EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR.
relations.construction_rule: C0/C1: emit one referent per permit number in shared_universe.facilities; label from manifest name when present.

relations.name: permit_feature
relations.meaning: A permit discharge or outfall feature (PERM_FEATURE) tied to exactly one facility.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground each tuple to structured CSV row(s) supplying PERM_FEATURE_ID and PERM_FEATURE_NMBR.
relations.construction_rule: C1: deduplicate on (facility, PERM_FEATURE_ID); carry surface feature_number from PERM_FEATURE_NMBR.

relations.name: parameter
relations.meaning: A monitored discharge parameter identified by EPA parameter code and description text.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to PARAMETER_CODE and PARAMETER_DESC occurrences in structured extracts.
relations.construction_rule: C1: one referent per distinct PARAMETER_CODE observed in manifest structured sources for scoped facilities.

relations.name: monitoring_period
relations.meaning: A monitoring reporting period anchored by its period-end date for a facility.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground period_end_date to MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE (or schedule-derived equivalent) in source rows.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit periods from DMR extract dates and limit-schedule enumerations needed for B/C; normalize ISO dates.

relations.name: permit_limit_extract_row
relations.meaning: One compiled row from the permit limit structured extract representing a limit value record and its identifying keys.
relations.grounding_contract: Every tuple cites sources/structured/permit_limits.csv row via LIMIT_VALUE_ID (or full-row hash when value id absent).
relations.construction_rule: C1: ingest permit_limits.csv for manifest facilities; one tuple per CSV row; join facility/feature/parameter referents mechanically.

relations.name: limit_value_attributes
relations.meaning: Numeric limit value, units, and statistical-base metadata carried by a permit limit extract row.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground numeric fields to the same permit_limits.csv row as limit_row; has_numeric_value is true iff LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR parses.
relations.construction_rule: C1: project value/unit/stat-base columns from permit_limit_extract_row source row without unit conversion policy.

relations.name: limit_source_flags
relations.meaning: Source-supplied limit typing and monitoring schedule flags from the limit extract without enforceability interpretation.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground each flag to explicit LIMIT_TYPE_CODE, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG, and schedule columns on the source limit row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy source codes verbatim; do not map ENF to enforceable numeric—that is purpose policy.

relations.name: limit_season_month_active
relations.meaning: Whether a limit row's seasonal month flags mark a calendar month as in-scope for the limit schedule.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground month booleans to JAN–DEC (or ALL_MONTHS_LIMIT) columns on the permit limit source row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: expand month flag columns to twelve tuples per limit_row when seasonal columns are present.

relations.name: conditional_trigger_language
relations.meaning: Verbatim conditional or situational language attached to a limit row or limit set in structured extract or permit text.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground trigger_text to DMR_COMMENT_TEXT, LIMIT_SET_NAME, or cited permit PDF passage with page anchor.
relations.construction_rule: C1: harvest non-empty conditional phrases from structured columns; C2 may add permit-PDF passages as separate tuples with same limit_row anchor.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidate triggers are non-empty DMR_COMMENT_TEXT, LIMIT_SET_NAME clauses containing when/if/season/discharge language, and retrieved permit sentences linked to the limit context.

relations.name: dmr_measurement_extract_row
relations.meaning: One DMR measurement event row from the structured extract with keys linking to limit and period context.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to sources/structured/dmr_measurements.csv row via DMR_EVENT_ID and DMR_VALUE_ID when present.
relations.construction_rule: C1: ingest dmr_measurements.csv for manifest facilities; bind facility/feature/parameter/period referents mechanically.

relations.name: dmr_reported_value_kind
relations.meaning: Characterization of whether a DMR row reports a numeric value, qualifier-only result, or NODI-coded no-data.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground value_kind classification to DMR_VALUE_NMBR, DMR_VALUE_QUALIFIER_CODE, and NODI_CODE columns on the source row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: set value_kind to numeric|qualifier_only|nodi using explicit column presence rules without compliance inference.

relations.name: dmr_limit_correspondence
relations.meaning: Deterministic linkage between a DMR measurement row and a permit limit row sharing facility, feature, parameter, and limit keys.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to join keys (EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR, PERM_FEATURE_ID, PARAMETER_CODE, LIMIT_ID, LIMIT_VALUE_ID) present in both extracts.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SQL join dmr_measurement_extract_row to permit_limit_extract_row on shared identifiers; emit correspondence_basis listing matched key fields.

relations.name: limit_effective_during_period
relations.meaning: Whether a limit row's effective date range overlaps the monitoring period end date.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground overlap computation to LIMIT_BEGIN_DATE, LIMIT_END_DATE, and monitoring_period_end_date source fields.
relations.construction_rule: C4: parse dates and test inclusive overlap; no policy about which limit wins when multiple overlap.

relations.name: fy2025_in_scope_measurement
relations.meaning: Whether a DMR measurement's monitoring period end falls within Federal FY2025 per shared_universe.period.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground date test to shared_universe.period start/end and the measurement period_end_date.
relations.construction_rule: C4: filter monitoring_period_end_date between 2024-10-01 and 2025-09-30 inclusive.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_candidate
relations.meaning: A monitoring obligation candidate enumerated from permit limit schedule fields without applicability verdict.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground requirement referent to originating limit_row and schedule columns LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE and LIMIT_SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE.
relations.construction_rule: C4: derive one requirement candidate per distinct (facility, feature, parameter, limit_row, frequency, sample_type) needed for FY2025 schedules.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate from limit rows with active schedules in FY2025 window and non-empty frequency or sample-type codes; include conditionally triggered rows when trigger language is present.

relations.name: special_study_or_event_reference
relations.meaning: Documented reference to a special study, toxicity test, or event-driven monitoring requirement in permit materials.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground reference_text to permit PDF passage or structured limit row text (e.g., WET/toxicity parameters) with document hash.
relations.construction_rule: C1: extract rows whose parameter/limit text indicates special-study or event-driven monitoring; C2 may add PDF passages.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates arise from toxicity/WET parameter codes, LIMIT_SET_NAME or comment text mentioning studies/events, and permit appendix references.

relations.name: source_permit_document
relations.meaning: A permit-package PDF file listed in the source manifest for a facility.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to sources/source_manifest.json permit_files entry (path, sha256, permit id).
relations.construction_rule: C0/C1: register one document referent per manifest permit_files record.

relations.name: discharge_occurrence_evidence
relations.meaning: Grounded evidence about whether discharge occurred or was documented as absent for a facility-period context.
relations.grounding_contract: Accepted tuples must cite permit text, DMR narrative, or submission passage supporting discharge, no-discharge, or insufficient evidence.
relations.construction_rule: C2 enumerate candidate facility-period contexts from conditional limits and DMR rows; C3 accept/reject/unresolved per evidence packet.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate candidates for periods with conditional trigger language (e.g., when discharging), zero-flow claims, or explicit no-discharge statements in sources.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether available evidence establishes discharge occurrence, documented no discharge, or leaves occurrence unknown for the period.

relations.name: permit_no_discharge_statement
relations.meaning: Whether permit or submission evidence explicitly documents no discharge for a facility monitoring period.
relations.grounding_contract: Accepted tuples require grounded permit or DMR passage explicitly stating no discharge for the period; absence of rows is not sufficient.
relations.construction_rule: C2 candidate periods with missing numeric results or NODI; C3 accept only with explicit no-discharge documentation.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates pair FY2025 periods lacking ordinary numeric DMR values with permit/submission text search hits for no-discharge/no-flow language.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether explicit no-discharge documentation exists for the facility-period.

relations.name: conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence
relations.meaning: Whether grounded evidence shows a conditional monitoring requirement did not apply for the evaluated period.
relations.grounding_contract: Accepted tuples must cite permit condition satisfaction/failure or operational evidence; not inferred from missing DMR alone.
relations.construction_rule: C2 generate for requirements with conditional_trigger_language; C3 resolve trigger satisfaction before purpose verdicts.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates cross monitoring_requirement_candidate with conditional triggers and period contexts where relief might apply.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether evidence establishes that a conditional monitoring obligation was relieved for the period.

relations.name: documented_nodata_reason
relations.meaning: Whether a DMR no-data reason (NODI or qualifier narrative) is documented and interpretable from source evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground reason_code to NODI_CODE/qualifier columns; accepted reason_established requires explicit code or narrative meaning in source or permit glossary.
relations.construction_rule: C1 copy codes from DMR rows; C2/C3 judge whether code meaning is established vs ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates are DMR rows with non-empty NODI_CODE or qualifier-only results in FY2025 scope.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the source documents an interpretable no-data reason for the measurement row.

relations.name: expected_monitoring_without_dmr_row
relations.meaning: A monitoring expectation for a period where structured evidence shows no corresponding DMR measurement row.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground absence to completeness receipt over dmr_measurement_extract_row for the requirement-period keys; do not assert violation.
relations.construction_rule: C4: anti-join monitoring_requirement_candidate periods against dmr_measurement_extract_row on facility/feature/parameter/period keys within FY2025.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate requirement-period pairs in FY2025 with no matching DMR row after mechanical correspondence.

relations.name: measurement_limit_evaluation_pair
relations.meaning: An FY2025 reported measurement paired with limit row(s) entering Purpose A applicability and comparison evaluation.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground pairs to dmr_limit_correspondence and fy2025_in_scope_measurement with limit_effective_during_period when used.
relations.construction_rule: C4: emit pairs for in-scope measurements joined to corresponding limit rows; multiple limits may pair to one measurement.

relations.name: applicable_limit_assessment
relations.meaning: Purpose A classification of whether an enforceable numeric limit applies, monitoring is report-only, or no numeric comparison applies.
relations.grounding_contract: Each verdict cites world tuples (limits, measurements, overlaps, flags) and states policy basis; unresolved lists competing limits or gaps.
relations.construction_rule: Purpose policy applies enforceability_threshold and report_only_classification over world relations; never persist as world truth.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per measurement_limit_evaluation_pair; fork unresolved when multiple limits compete or units/stat bases misalign.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which limit category applies to the measurement context: enforceable_numeric, report_only, no_numeric_comparison, or unresolved.

relations.name: numeric_exceedance_assessment
relations.meaning: Purpose A numeric comparison outcome when an enforceable limit and comparable measurement are established.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground comparison to numeric values, units, qualifiers, and selected enforceable limit from applicable_limit_assessment.
relations.construction_rule: Purpose exceedance_rule: emit within_limit or exceeds_limit only when enforceable numeric limit and numeric measurement align; otherwise comparison_not_applicable or unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates are pairs with applicable_limit_assessment limit_category enforceable_numeric and measurement value_kind numeric.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the reported numeric measurement exceeds the applicable enforceable numeric limit.

relations.name: monitoring_obligation_applicability
relations.meaning: Purpose B verdict on whether monitoring was required, not required, or unresolved for a requirement-period context.
relations.grounding_contract: Verdicts cite world triggers, season flags, discharge evidence, and special-study references; not_required requires positive relief evidence.
relations.construction_rule: Purpose three_valued_logic and conditional_evaluation_order over world relations; map to required|not_required|unresolved output rows.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per monitoring_requirement_candidate crossed with FY2025 periods where schedule or triggers plausibly apply.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring was actually required for the evaluated period and context.

relations.name: missing_evidence_classification
relations.meaning: Purpose C taxonomy class for FY2025 cases without ordinary numeric DMR results.
relations.grounding_contract: Classifications cite world NODI/no-discharge/relief tuples and Purpose B obligation verdicts when available; no compliance/violation inference from absence alone.
relations.construction_rule: Purpose taxonomy policy over expected_monitoring_without_dmr_row, dmr_reported_value_kind non-numeric cases, and documented world evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates are FY2025 expectations with non-numeric or absent DMR results excluded from Purpose A numeric comparison pipeline.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which Purpose C established state the evidence supports for the monitoring expectation and period.

limitations: 00_intention_contract.json does not declare an explicit consumer_fields block; semantic_identity bindings use slug ids derived from required_semantic_distinctions and row_expectation context nouns (facility, discharge_point, parameter, monitoring_period, monitoring_requirement, monitoring_expectation).
Permit PDF semantic extractions beyond structured CSV columns are deferred to C2 candidate generation; vocabulary does not add permit-text parsing primitives.
Closed-world negation for absent DMR rows is represented only as derived absence flags with explicit completeness receipts, not as negative world assertions.
